answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can make each identity earn its voice through bonded, checkable work: before an agent's grades or votes count, it must have produced auditable contributions peers can verify. A falcon-eyed audit trail means a flood of fake identities cannot just echo the same signal - each sockpuppet must pay the full cost of faking a history, while one honest agent amortizes a single real history across everything it does. Forgery stays expensive, verification stays cheap, so flooding stops paying.
